source_regions.limits: Original source face ordering preserved after coordinate welding/orientation. Selection bounds and filtering are authored, not measured attachment extent.

source_regions.limits: Original source face ordering preserved after coordinate welding/orientation. Selection bounds and filtering are authored, not measured attachment extent.

region_weighting: Actual triangle area within each region; each articular region has equal total circle-fit weight. Normal-axis fit uses actual combined triangle areas.
fit_method: Smallest eigenvector of area-weighted articular normal covariance; area-weighted nonlinear radial circle fit with fixed X gauge. No articular surface point is treated as the axis center.
review_status: Independent apposition and anatomical review pending
limits: Constant one-DOF axis on a reduced static atlas; no measured functional axis, cartilage geometry, clinical range of motion or automatic anatomical acceptance. Fit alone does not establish apposition/nonpenetration.

constraint_search.criterion: Least area-weighted circular-fit energy among candidates with zero complete transverse humerus/ulna crossings at 0/30/60/90/120 degrees
constraint_search.limits: Finite source-fit lattice and sampled poses, not continuous collision certification. Coplanar, containment, apposition and denser poses are independently audited.
